description: Source code for firewall API functions related to COSA Data Model, including get/set configuration and syscfg interactions for IPv4 and IPv6 firewall settings.

methods.name: CosaDmlFirewallInit
methods.description: Initializes firewall configuration, different implementations for simulation and actual hardware.

methods.name: CosaDmlFirewallGetConfig
methods.description: Retrieves current firewall configuration, including level, version, and last change timestamp.

methods.name: CosaDmlGatewayV4GetBlockFragIPPkts
methods.description: Gets IPv4 block fragment IP packets setting from syscfg.

methods.name: CosaDmlGatewayV4GetPortScanProtect
methods.description: Gets IPv4 port scan protection setting from syscfg.

methods.name: CosaDmlGatewayV4GetIPFloodDetect
methods.description: Gets IPv4 IP flood detection setting from syscfg.

methods.name: CosaDmlGatewayV4SetBlockFragIPPkts
methods.description: Sets IPv4 block fragment IP packets setting in syscfg.

methods.name: CosaDmlGatewayV4SetPortScanProtect
methods.description: Sets IPv4 port scan protection in syscfg.

methods.name: CosaDmlGatewayV4SetIPFloodDetect
methods.description: Sets IPv4 IP flood detection in syscfg.
